title: The lower bound of shifted primes with large prime factors
summary: In this paper, we consider the asymptotic density of $T_c(x):=\#\{p\leq x:P^+(p-1)\geq p^c\}$, where $P^+(n)$ denote the largest prime factor of $n$. We show that for $x\rightarrow\infty$, for any $0 0$ for $11/32 0.0436$.
